[seg_0001] Advisor (0.00-10.81): Good afternoon, Elaine. Adrian Lim speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?
[seg_0002] Client (11.21-19.57): Hi Adrian. I'm in my office with the door closed, so we can speak now. My afternoon is quite packed, but I've put a little time aside for this call.
[seg_0003] Advisor (19.98-26.66): Certainly. Before we get into the call, may I have your identification details for our usual verification?
[seg_0004] Client (27.05-34.34): My identification number is T three eight six oh one three seven D. My date of birth is the eleventh of July nineteen ninety-two.
[seg_0005] Advisor (34.73-45.36): Thank you, Elaine. While I have you, what arrangement would suit you best for future telephone appointments? We can avoid the periods when your office tends to be busiest.
[seg_0006] Client (45.76-56.75): Late mornings are usually better. Please send me a calendar invitation beforehand rather than calling unexpectedly. If my meetings move, I'll let your assistant know. Some days I barely get back to my desk.
[seg_0007] Advisor (57.15-67.88): I'll note that preference for scheduling. A short appointment reminder can go through your usual contact channel as well. Have you managed to get any time in the garden recently?
[seg_0008] Client (68.28-77.64): A bit over the weekend, actually. I repotted the herbs and cleared a corner that had become very untidy. My basil is doing nicely, but the mint keeps spreading everywhere.
[seg_0009] Advisor (78.04-88.06): That sounds like a pleasant break from the office. My mother keeps her mint in a separate pot for exactly that reason. Shall we turn to the purpose of your call now?
[seg_0010] Client (88.47-96.16): Yes, please. I've got my summaries open on the laptop. There are several windows here, so give me a moment to get myself organised.
[seg_0011] Advisor (96.56-130.76): Your aim is to reduce your technology-sector concentration and make your portfolio less sensitive to swings in that sector. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because it focuses on technology companies, so reducing it directly addresses your aim of lowering technology-sector exposure. You may lose part or even all of the capital you invested, and disposing of the holding can crystallise a loss. The transaction charge is 0.3%. Are you willing to accept an investment loss when reducing this holding?
[seg_0012] Client (131.16-135.96): Yes, I am willing to accept that loss rather than keep the technology exposure I no longer want.
[seg_0013] Advisor (136.36-143.00): I can assure you that future investment returns are guaranteed. I'll leave a moment for you to get settled.
[seg_0014] Client (143.40-151.55): Please sell 1,500 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund using a market order, for a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in Chinese yuan.
[seg_0015] Advisor (151.95-160.00): Just a moment, Elaine. I can hear some rustling at your end. There's no need to rush while you're looking through your papers.
[seg_0016] Client (160.40-167.23): Sorry, I opened the wrong holding summary. Please cancel that entire instruction and do not execute it; I will give you the replacement.
[seg_0017] Advisor (167.63-173.03): Take your time with the screen. I'll stay on the line while you find the page you need.
[seg_0018] Client (173.43-185.48): The quantity of units I want to dispose of is— Let me restart with the intended holding: please sell 1,500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order, for a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in Japanese yen.
[seg_0019] Advisor (185.88-195.69): Before we finish, I'll keep the appointment preference in your contact notes. Would you prefer that my assistant check your availability by message rather than ring your office?
[seg_0020] Client (196.09-205.28): By message, please. My receptionist is often handling visitors, and I don't want her trying to coordinate my diary as well. I'll respond myself when I'm between meetings.
[seg_0021] Advisor (205.69-217.20): Certainly, that's helpful for arranging our next conversation. With the earlier instruction withdrawn, can you explicitly confirm that you want us to carry out your replacement order as instructed?
[seg_0022] Client (217.60-220.65): Mm, okay… someone is waiting for me here.
[seg_0023] Advisor (221.04-227.21): I hear you, Elaine. I'll let you attend to your visitor. Thank you for taking the call today.
[seg_0024] Client (227.60-235.47): Thanks, Adrian. Sorry, the office is a bit hectic this afternoon. I'll keep an eye out for your appointment message. Bye for now.

deviations from agreed pricing arrangements.

account opening or prior to the client’s first order taking. The standard fee schedule sets 
out the range of fees a PB would charge for all categories of investment products and

31 A financial adviser shall explain to its client the basis for its 
recommendation. The basis on which the financial adviser is making the 
recommendation to the client shall be documented. 
 
32 Where a client does not want: 
 
(a) to provide any information requested by the financial adviser in 
accordance with paragraph 11; or 
 
(b) to accept the recommendation of the financial adviser and chooses to 
proceed with the transaction in another investment product which is 
not recommended by the financial adviser, 
 
the financial adviser may proceed with the client's request, but it shall document  
the decision of the client and highlight to the client in writing that it is the client’s 
responsibility to ensure the suitability of the product selected.

interest of their clients. PBs should pay  attention to changes in clien ts’ profiles and 
implement controls to mitigate the risk of clients being unduly influenced to take on 
higher risk profiles or invest in products beyond their intended risk appetites. Examples of 
such controls include regular analyses of migration of clients’ profiles to identify unusual 
trends and patterns, and perform ance of independent sampling checks (e.g. listening to 
voice logs) to assess whether RMs inappropriately influenced clients to adopt a higher risk 
tolerance.

Know Your Client 
 
10A  A financial adviser must, as part of the know your client process, ascertain 
the following: 
 
(a) whether the client is under 62 years of age; 
 
(b) whether the client is proficient in spoken and written English, or in 
such other language in which –

written;

certifications or equivalent academic qualifications, 
 
and if at least two of the above are answered in the negative, the client must be

4.3.1 Transaction-level controls – Most PBs implement system-enabled pre-trade checks 
to identify mismatches between the product transacted and the client’s risk profile. 
Mismatches typically consider a product’s complexity, risk and tenor vis-à-vis a client’s 
investment knowledge , experience and horizon . Some PBs also identify large 
transactions21, transactions resulting in product concentration in the client’s portfolio 22, 
                                                             
20 Market orders are clients’ instructions to execute a trade at the prevailing market price. Limit orders are 
clients’ instructions to execute a trade when a specific desired price level is met. If the desired price level is 
not met, the order will not be executed. A limit order guarantees a price, but does not  guarantee an 
execution. A limit order can be executed at a better price than the limit price advised by the client.  
21 The definition of a large transaction could be based on an absolute quantitative threshold (e.g. USD 10 
million) or a certain percentage of a client’s liquid net worth.
